response: published derived path_loss_db from dataset PL appendix; not received power, RSRP or SINR
model: PL(d) = FSPL(3.6 GHz, 1 m) + 10 * n_fixed * log10(d / 1 m) + delta_PL_dataset

fixed_parameters.path_loss_exponent_source: Phase 14 project simulation assumption; not estimated from public measurements

split_unit: entire environment-height route file; no point-level random split

training_distance_identifiability_audit.rationale: training distance spans less than one decade and distance is confounded with four environment-height groups

bootstrap.method: equal-weight measurement-group means with whole route-file cluster bootstrap

holdout_bootstrap.method: paired resampling of whole holdout environment-height files

primary_comparison: candidate versus exact Phase 14 mean path-loss baseline on identical over-water holdout rows
secondary_comparison: candidate versus frequency-matched 3.6 GHz free-space/log-distance baseline on identical over-water holdout rows
acceptance_rule: do not claim improvement absent documented per-measurement uncertainty, a group-bootstrap 95% interval below zero against the exact Phase 14 baseline, and an effect exceeding measurement uncertainty
holdout_group_count_warning: two independent environment-height groups only; intervals are descriptive and low-resolution
reason_not_applied: Public non-urban 3.6 GHz path-loss labels do not identify target-device transmit power, antenna gains, receiver sensitivity, urban obstruction, or reliable link-failure labels
